def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    stripe = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                  if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 4)
    stripe_color = grid[stripe][0]

    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (4, stripe_color)]
    obj_row = min(r for r, c in cells)
    obj_color = grid[obj_row][cells[0][1]]
    cols = [c for r, c in cells if r == obj_row]

    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = 4

    direction = 1 if obj_row > stripe else -1
    target = stripe + direction
    for c in cols:
        out[target][c] = obj_color

    trail = target + direction
    if 0 <= trail < h:
        out[trail] = [8] * w

    return out
